capabilities: Edit pages as structured JSON block trees with true nesting, columns, tables and media blocks
Import Markdown notes and export pages losslessly as Markdown, Word (docx) and PDF
Create page, heading and block references that surface in Obsidian's backlinks, graph, search and page preview
Render pages through Obsidian's native Markdown reading mode with wikilinks, math and Mermaid
Recover and diagnose data with journals, snapshots, conflict copies and a trash folder
disambiguation: Not a workspace-layout manager; despite the name it is a Notion-style structured block editor for page content.
extras: Interface language is Simplified Chinese only; commands and menus appear in Chinese with no English UI yet. Licensed under GPLv3. Data lives in a .blockspace folder that should be included in backups and never deleted while the plugin runs. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian.
intentEvidence: A local-first, Notion-style structured block workspace that lives inside Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian stores notes as plain Markdown text, so real nesting, column layouts and rich-text structure rely on text conventions instead of first-class structured data.

relations.evidence: SiYuan-style ((blockId "label")) references are converted to structured references as you type or paste.

summary: Notion-style block editor that stores pages as structured JSON block trees and bridges them into Obsidian's backlinks, graph and search.
